title: Create User with Email empty says "Either email or phoneNumber is required" and the dialog marks nothing required (#27521 row 10)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 10 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator creating a user. What happens: submitting Create User with Email empty answers "Either email or phoneNumber is required" — `phoneNumber` is an API key and the form has no phone field, so the message names something the administrator cannot see; the dialog shows no required marks at all. Reach: every administrator creating a user.

## Mechanism

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts` line 697 on main: `return badRequest('Either email or phoneNumber is required');`.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`: the Create User action's params are all declared optional, so no required mark is drawn.

Read in the 18.3.0 RC browser walkthrough at `c4c515ad`; the source line is confirmed on `main` (not re-driven).

## Wanted

"Email is required" (or "Email or phone number is required" where phone sign-in is on), and the Email param marked required when phone sign-in is off.

## Acceptance

- [ ] With phone sign-in off, Create User with Email empty answers a message naming Email only, in user words, and the Email param shows a required mark.
- [ ] With phone sign-in on, the message names email or phone number in user words.
- [ ] The refusal carries a code the console can localise.

Refs #27521
